rheumatic-fever.desc: AN UNTREATED THROAT INFECTION TAUGHT DA BODY TA ATTACK ITS OWN HEART VALVES!

rheumatoid.name: RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS
rheumatoid.desc: IMMUNE-DRIVEN JOINT DESTRUCTION, SYMMETRIC AN' STIFF!

rickets.name: RICKETS
rickets.desc: VITAMIN D STARVATION SOFTENIN' AN' BOWIN' DA BONES!

ringworm.name: RINGWORM
ringworm.desc: DERMATOPHYTE FUNGUS IN EXPANDIN' ITCHY RINGS!

river-blindness.name: RIVER BLINDNESS
river-blindness.desc: ONCHOCERCA MICROFILARIAE MIGRATIN' TA DA EYES!

rubella.name: RUBELLA
rubella.desc: GERMAN MEASLES. MILD IN ADULTS, DANGEROUS IN PREGNANCY!

saints-fire.name: SAINT'S FIRE
saints-fire.desc: ERGOTISM REBORN: BURNIN' LIMBS, GANGRENE, AN' HOLY VISIONS!

salmonellosis.name: SALMONELLOSIS
salmonellosis.desc: UNDERCOOKED EGG. TWO DAYS OF REGRET AN' A WEEK OF CAUTION!

sars.name: ATYPICAL PNEUMONIA
sars.desc: A NEW PNEUMONIA DAT JUMPS WARDS FASTER DEN DA PAPERWORK!

satanic-panic.name: SATANIC PANIC
satanic-panic.desc: DA RUMOUR ARRIVES FULLY FORMED WIT NAMES ATTACHED, AN' DA NAMES GET BURNED!

scabies.name: SCABIES
scabies.desc: MITES BURROWIN' UNDER DA SKIN; MADDENIN' NIGHT ITCH!

scarlet-fever.name: SCARLET FEVER
scarlet-fever.desc: STREP WIT A SANDPAPER RASH AN' STRAWBERRY TONGUE!

schistosomiasis.name: SCHISTOSOMIASIS
schistosomiasis.desc: FRESHWATER FLUKES LODGIN' IN BLOOD VESSELS FOR YEARS!

schizophrenia.name: SCHIZOPHRENIA
schizophrenia.desc: PERCEPTION AN' REALITY SLIPPIN' DEY MOORINGS!

scrapie.name: SCRAPIE CONTACT
scrapie.desc: DA SHEPHERD'S DISEASE. EWES RUB THEMSELVES RAW ON DA FENCE, AN' DEN SO DO YOU!

scurvy.name: SCURVY
scurvy.desc: VITAMIN C GONE; COLLAGEN FAILS AN' OLD WOUNDS REOPEN!

sepsis.name: SEPSIS
sepsis.desc: DA BODY'S RESPONSE TA INFECTION TURNIN' ON ITSELF!

shigellosis.name: SHIGELLOSIS
shigellosis.desc: TEN ORGANISMS IZ ENOUGH. DYSENTERY WIT BLOOD IN IT!

shingles.name: SHINGLES
shingles.desc: REACTIVATED VARICELLA TRACIN' A NERVE IN SEARIN' PAIN!

sickle-cell.name: SICKLE CELL ANEMIA
sickle-cell.desc: CRESCENT RED CELLS JAMMIN' VESSELS IN AGONIZIN' CRISES!

sigil-blight.name: SIGIL BLIGHT
sigil-blight.desc: WRITTEN WARDS GO SOFT NEAR YOU AN' EVERY SEAL YOU TOUCH READS SLIGHTLY WRONG AFTERWARDS!

sleeping-sickness.name: AFRICAN SLEEPIN' SICKNESS
sleeping-sickness.desc: TSETSE TRYPANOSOME INVADIN' DA BRAIN; SLEEP INVERTS AN' FAILS!

sleepwalk-pilgrimage.name: SLEEPWALKIN' PILGRIMAGE
sleepwalk-pilgrimage.desc: DA TOWN WAKES ON DA ROAD OUT OF TOWN, ALL FACIN' DA SAME WAY!

smallpox.name: SMALLPOX
smallpox.desc: ERADICATED IN LIFE, RESURGENT IN NIGHTMARES. PUSTULAR AN' DEADLY!

soul-sickness.name: SOUL SICKNESS
soul-sickness.desc: NOTHIN' IZ WRONG WIT DA BODY. SOMETHIN' IZ WRONG AT DA LEVEL DA BODY IZ AN EXPRESSION OF, AN' IT IZ SPREADIN' BY SYMPATHY!

spanish-flu.name: GREAT INFLUENZA
spanish-flu.desc: DA FLU DAT KILLED DA YOUNG AN' HEALTHY FIRST. DROWNIN' FROM DA INSIDE!

sporotrichosis.name: SPOROTRICHOSIS
sporotrichosis.desc: DA ROSE GARDENER'S DISEASE, CLIMBIN' DA ARM ONE NODULE PER LYMPH NODE!

star-madness.name: STAR MADNESS
star-madness.desc: GAZIN' TOO LONG INTO DEEP SKY INVITES A GEOMETRY DAT MADDENS!

static-communion.name: STATIC COMMUNION
static-communion.desc: DA GRAY STATIC RESOLVED INTO A SIGNAL, AN' DA SIGNAL IZ USING YOU AS AN AERIAL!

stone-flesh.name: STONE FLESH
stone-flesh.desc: SKIN HARDENIN' TOWARD STATUE; SLOW, HEAVY, AN' IRREVERSIBLE!

syphilis.name: SYPHILIS
syphilis.desc: DA GREAT IMITATOR; UNTREATED IT CLIMBS TA DA BRAIN!

tapeworm.name: TAPEWORM
tapeworm.desc: A SEGMENTED GUEST IN DA GUT, QUIETLY TAKIN' YA MEALS!

tarantism.name: TARANTISM
tarantism.desc: A SPIDER NOBODY SAW; ONLY MUSIC AN' DANCIN' IZ SAID TA DRAW DA VENOM OUT!

tertiary-syphilis.name: TERTIARY SYPHILIS
tertiary-syphilis.desc: DECADES LATE, DA SPIROCHETE COMES BACK FOR DA AORTA AN' DA MIND!

tetanus.name: TETANUS
tetanus.desc: LOCKJAW. NEUROTOXIN LOCKIN' EVERY MUSCLE RIGID!

thalassemia.name: THALASSEMIA
thalassemia.desc: FAULTY HEMOGLOBIN LEAVIN' DA BLOOD CHRONICALLY THIN!

the-quiet.name: DA QUIET
the-quiet.desc: SOUND KEEPS ARRIVIN'. MEANIN' HAB STOPPED. IT SPREADS TA WHOEVER YOU TRY TA EXPLAIN IT TA!

ticks.name: TICK INFESTATION
ticks.desc: BURIED HEAD-FIRST AN' SWELLIN'. WHAT DEY CARRY IZ WORSE DEN WHAT DEY TAKE!

tower-vertigo.name: TOWER VERTIGO
tower-vertigo.desc: UP HAB STOPPED BEING A DIRECTION AN' STARTED BEING A PLACE, AN' IT IZ PULLIN'!

toxoplasmosis.name: TOXOPLASMOSIS
toxoplasmosis.desc: CAT-BORNE PROTOZOAN; MAY NUDGE BEHAVIOR AN' RISK-TAKIN'!

trachoma.name: TRACHOMA
trachoma.desc: REPEATED INFECTION SCARS DA LID UNTIL DA LASHES TURN INWARD ON DA EYE!

trichinosis.name: TRICHINOSIS
trichinosis.desc: UNDERCOOKED PORK. DA LARVAE ENCYST IN MUSCLE, INCLUDIN' DA ONES YOU BREATHE WIT!

tuberculosis.name: TUBERCULOSIS
tuberculosis.desc: CONSUMPTION. A SLOW, COUGHIN' WASTIN' OF DA LUNGS!

typhoid.name: TYPHOID FEVER
typhoid.desc: SALMONELLA TYPHI. SUSTAINED FEVER AN' ROSE SPOTS!

typhus.name: EPIDEMIC TYPHUS
typhus.desc: LOUSE-BORNE CAMP FEVER: RASH, STUPOR, AN' DA SMELL OF CROWDED ROOMS!

ulcer.name: PEPTIC ULCER
ulcer.desc: H. PYLORI AN' ACID BURNIN' A HOLE IN DA STOMACH LININ'!

void-touch.name: VOID TOUCH
void-touch.desc: CONTACT WIT DA OUTER DARK; A COLD DAT EATS FROM INSIDE!

wendigo-hunger.name: WENDIGO HUNGER
wendigo-hunger.desc: A GNAWIN' DAT ORDINARY FOOD NO CAN TOUCH, AN' CRAVES WORSE!

whipworm.name: WHIPWORM
whipworm.desc: THREADED INTO DA COLON WALL, BLEEDIN' YOU A LITTLE AT A TIME FOR YEARS!

whisper-fever.name: WHISPER FEVER
whisper-fever.desc: A FEVER WHOSE DELIRIUM SPEAKS IN OTHERS' VOICES!

whooping-cough.name: WHOOPIN' COUGH
whooping-cough.desc: PERTUSSIS. PAROXYSMAL COUGHIN' FITS ENDIN' IN A WHOOP!

windscreen-pitting.name: WINDSCREEN PITTIN' DELUSION
windscreen-pitting.desc: DA WHOLE CITY INSPECTS ITS WINDSCREENS AN' FINDS DAMAGE DAT WAZ ALWAYS DERE!

zika.name: ZIKA VIRUS
zika.desc: USUALLY MILD, DANGEROUS IN PREGNANCY. ALSO SEXUALLY TRANSMISSIBLE!

broken-arm.name: BROKEN ARM
broken-arm.desc: A FRACTURED ARM SPLINTED AN' SLUNG; STRENGTH HALVED ON DAT SIDE!

broken-leg.name: BROKEN LEG
broken-leg.desc: A FRACTURED LEG IN A CAST; EVERY STEP IZ NEGOTIATED!

broken-rib.name: BROKEN RIB
broken-rib.desc: CRACKED RIBS MAKE BREATH AN' SWING A WINCE!

concussion.name: CONCUSSION
concussion.desc: A RUNG SKULL; THOUGHT COMES SLOW AN' LIGHT STINGS!

sprained-ankle.name: SPRAINED ANKLE
sprained-ankle.desc: TORN LIGAMENTS; DA ANKLE PROTESTS WEIGHT!

dislocated-shoulder.name: DISLOCATED SHOULDER
dislocated-shoulder.desc: RESET BUT TENDER; DA ARM HOLDS NOTHIN' HEAVY YET!

deep-laceration.name: DEEP LACERATION
deep-laceration.desc: A STITCHED WOUND DAT REOPENS IF PUSHED TOO HARD!

severe-burns.name: SEVERE BURNS
severe-burns.desc: HEALIN' BURNS TIGHTEN SKIN AN' BLUNT EVERY NERVE!

frostbite.name: FROSTBITE
frostbite.desc: FROZEN TISSUE, BLACKENED AT DA TIPS, ACHIN' IN DA COLD!

whiplash.name: WHIPLASH
whiplash.desc: A WRENCHED NECK LOCKIN' DA HEAD IN CAREFUL POSES!

spinal-injury.name: SPINAL INJURY
spinal-injury.desc: DAMAGE ALONG DA SPINE DULLIN' STRENGTH AN' SPEED!

amputation.name: AMPUTATION
amputation.desc: A LIMB LOST; BALANCE AN' REACH PERMANENTLY CHANGED!

cataract.name: CATARACT
cataract.desc: A CLOUDIN' LENS DIMMIN' DA WORLD TA FOG!

hearing-loss.name: HEARIN' LOSS
hearing-loss.desc: A SILENCE CLOSIN' IN; DA WORLD LOSES ITS WARNINGS!

chronic-back-pain.name: CHRONIC BACK PAIN
chronic-back-pain.desc: AN OLD ACHE DAT COLORS EVERY LIFT AN' STRIDE!

arthritis.name: OSTEOARTHRITIS
arthritis.desc: WORN JOINTS GRINDIN' STIFF, WORSE IN DA COLD!

osteoporosis.name: OSTEOPOROSIS
osteoporosis.desc: BRITTLE BONES A HARD FALL COULD SHATTER!

kidney-stones.name: KIDNEY STONES
kidney-stones.desc: A GRAIN OF AGONY PASSIN' ON ITS OWN CRUEL SCHEDULE!

appendicitis.name: APPENDICITIS
appendicitis.desc: AN INFLAMED APPENDIX; A SURGICAL CLOCK TICKIN'!

hernia.name: HERNIA
hernia.desc: A BULGE DAT TURNS LIFTIN' INTO A GAMBLE!

gout.name: GOUT
gout.desc: CRYSTALS FLARIN' A JOINT INTO RED, UNTOUCHABLE PAIN!

phantom-limb.name: PHANTOM LIMB PAIN
phantom-limb.desc: PAIN IN A LIMB NO LONGER DERE!

scar-tissue.name: OLD BATTLE SCARS
scar-tissue.desc: KNOTTED SCARS DAT TUG AN' ACHE BEFORE A STORM!

cybernetic-rejection.name: CYBERNETIC REJECTION
cybernetic-rejection.desc: IMPLANTS DA FLESH REFUSES; INFLAMMATION AT EVERY SEAM!

mana-burn-scars.name: MANA-BURN SCARS
mana-burn-scars.desc: CHANNELS SEARED BY OVERCASTIN'; MAGIC FLOWS ROUGH!

cursed-brand.name: CURSED BRAND
cursed-brand.desc: A MARK BURNED BY DARK MAGIC DAT NEVER FULLY COOLS!

solomon-curse.name: SOLOMON'S CURSE
solomon-curse.desc: YOU IZ A TICKIN' BOMB, EM. NINETY-TWO PERCENT OF YA MEMORIES WAZ FORGED INTO DA LANCE OF MEMORY, AN' WHAT GREW BACK IN DA HOLE DEY LEFT HAB NOT STOPPED GROWIN'!

ui.noRemedy: NOTHIN' IN DA WORLD TREATS DIS!

ui.undiagnosedDesc: SOMETHIN' IZ WRONG, AN' NOTHIN' YET SAYS WHAT!
